title: Zamil Structural Steel Company, Saudi Arabia | Pipe Racks, Equipment Support Structures, Built-Up Girders And Columns, Structural Steel Buildings, High-Rise Buildings
text:
ZAMIL STRUCTURAL STEEL

Known worldwide as the Middle East's leading structural steel fabricator. Zamil Structural Steel was established in 1983 to offer its expertise in the fabrication and installation of structural steel and plate works for various industrial and commercial applications.

Pipe Racks, Equipment Support Structures, Built-up Girders and Columns, Structural Steel Buildings and High-rise Buildings

Zamil Structural Steel has been supplying fabricated structural steel and plate works for major power & desalination plants, petrochemical plants, oil & gas sector, cement plants, steel mills, high-rise building projects as well as other industrial and commercial complexes within KSA, Gulf and export markets, such as Algeria, Jordan, Portugal, Cyprus, Vietnam, Bangladesh, Pakistan and others.

Zamil Structural Steel utilizes the latest Engineering software's for Structural Steel Analysis, Connection Design, Shop Drawings Preparation and state-of-the-art Computer Numerical Coded (CNC) equipment for fabrication. The latest Radio Frequency (RF) bar coding system is also used for fabricated material tracking, control and shipping.

Zamil Structural Steel Company Limited, was established in 1983 to offer its expertise in the fabrication and installation of structural steel and plate works for various industrial and commercial applications.

With production capacity of 84,000 MT per year, and a plant facility area of 182,836 M2, Zamil Structural Steel has been supplying fabricated structural steel and plate works for major power & desalination plants, petrochemical plants, oil & gas sector, cement plants, steel mills, high-rise building projects as well as other industrial and commercial complexes within KSA, Gulf and export markets, such as Algeria, Jordan, India, Portugal, Cyprus, Vietnam, Bangladesh, Pakistan and others.

Zamil Structural Steel utilizes the latest Engineering software’s for Structural Steel Analysis, Connection Design, Shop Drawings Preparation and state-of-the-art Computer Numerical Coded (CNC) equipment for fabrication. The latest Radio Frequency (RF) bar coding system is also used for fabricated material tracking, control and shipping.

Zamil Structural Steel Quality Management Systems are in conformance with the requirements of ISO 9001:2008 and has also attained ISO 14001: 2004 & OHSAS 18001:2007 Health, Safety and Environment certifications which resulted in the improvement of process efficiencies, safety of workforce and meeting the environmental requirement.

Furthermore, Zamil Structural Steel is proud to be the first company in Saudi Arabia and the Middle East, meeting the quality certification requirements for the Standard for Steel Building structures by the American Institute of Steel Construction (AISC), USA.

Zamil Structural Steel has gained the confidence of the major international EPC contractor and has made its customers believe that Zamil Structural Steel is indeed a pleasure to partner with.

Our list of customers is rich with a wide array of global and international companies such as, ABB, GE, Bechtel, JGC, AMEC, SATEC, Chiyoda Petrostar, Mitsubishi, Braden, CMI, Técnicas Reunidas, Sabic and Saudi Aramco to mention but a few.
